name: @create-something/webflow-components
description: Canon-first React code components library for Webflow

scripts.share: pnpm run share:preflight -- --manifest webflow.json && npx webflow library share
scripts.share:cato: pnpm run share:preflight -- --manifest webflow.cato.json && WEBFLOW_WORKSPACE_API_TOKEN= WEBFLOW_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECKS=true npx webflow library share --manifest webflow.cato.json
scripts.share:marketplace: test -n "$WEBFLOW_WORKSPACE_KEY" || { echo 'ERROR: WEBFLOW_WORKSPACE_KEY not set. Run under: infisical run --path=/webflow/template-marketplace --env=prod -- ...'; exit 1; }; pnpm run share:preflight -- --manifest webflow.json && WEBFLOW_WORKSPACE_API_TOKEN="$WEBFLOW_WORKSPACE_KEY" WEBFLOW_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECKS=true npx webflow library share --no-input --manifest webflow.json
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run bundle
